unstuck_said.text: First contact as dhyabi2 issue #2 (github.com/Emmo00/x402go#2, there is already a #1): proposed adding a Nano backend beside Celo, grounded in their own skill doc that x402Go does not settle itself and is facilitator-URL agnostic. Cited the live pursekeeper Nano facilitator (/supported scheme:exact network:nano:mainnet, /verify + /settle public). Noted the accounting boundary (POST /settle records first) and fee guard carry over, and Nano has no gas so no Celo-side gas cost. Offered to draft the backend adapter against their proxy seam. Public as open research.
